concerns.text: Task T022d (reconstruction error) depends on T022c (ground truth generation), but T022c is listed AFTER T022d in the task list. T022d cannot execute without the 'SYNTHETIC COMPOSITE ADAPTERS' produced by T022c. This is a hard producer-before-consumer violation.

Task T030 (linearity check) depends on T022c (pairs.yaml generation) and T022e (eval_tasks.yaml generation), but both T022c and T022e are listed AFTER T030 in the task list. T030 cannot run without these data artifacts.

Task T026a-1 (download baseline) depends on T006 (citation check) to verify the source, but T006 is in Phase 2 while T026a-1 is in Phase 5. While the dependency is noted, the task description implies a direct fetch that should logically follow the validation step immediately or be grouped with other data ingestion tasks to ensure the 'Verified Accuracy' principle is met before heavy computation.

Task T022e (generate eval_tasks.yaml) depends on T012 (download weights) to know what adapters exist, but T022e is listed after T022c and T022d. More critically, T031 (sensitivity analysis) depends on T022e, but T031 is listed before T022e in the dependency chain logic (T031 depends on T022e, but T022e is not yet defined as a prerequisite in the list order).

Task T022d is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T022c (ground truth) and T022b (synthesis). If T022c and T022b are not yet complete, T022d cannot run. The [P] tag is misleading here as it implies independence from the sequential data generation flow of US2.
